**Finding: MISSING** (LOL-CAP, critical)

The Site Development and Hosting Agreement has no limitation of liability provision at all. I confirmed this by scanning every section: searches for "liability" surface only the No Joint Venture clause (p0061–p0062), and "damages" / "indemnif" return nothing. Neither the Warranties article (Section 9) nor General Provisions (Section 10) contains a cap, a consequential-damages exclusion, or any aggregate-liability language.

That leaves both Parties — including the Company — exposed to unlimited direct and consequential liability, which fails even the fallback position (mutual 12-month fee cap with carve-outs).

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** new Section 10.9 inserted after p0070, inside General Provisions so it survives under Section 10.7:
- Mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' amounts paid or payable by the Company to HDI and USD 1,000,000 (fee basis tracks the Section 3 revenue-share, so the cap is not illusory).
- Mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages.
- Uncapped carve-outs for confidentiality (Section 8), data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud, and IP infringement.
- Company's payment obligations under Sections 3 and 4.2 (including the Termination Payment) expressly excluded from the cap.
